descriptions.logreg: Logistic regression: an interpretable linear classification baseline that outputs probabilities and works well for quickly assessing linear separability.
descriptions.rf: Random forest: an ensemble of decision trees that resists overfitting and provides feature importance.
descriptions.svm: Support vector machine: suitable for small-to-medium samples and high-dimensional data, with probabilities calibrated using Platt scaling.
descriptions.xgboost: XGBoost gradient-boosted trees: strong performance on tabular data with SHAP explanation support.
descriptions.lightgbm: LightGBM: histogram-accelerated gradient-boosted trees that train faster on large samples.
descriptions.catboost: CatBoost: gradient-boosted trees with automatic handling of categorical features.
descriptions.lasso: Lasso linear regression: L1 regularization performs automatic feature selection and produces a sparse, interpretable model.
descriptions.elasticnet: Elastic net: combined L1 and L2 regularization that balances feature selection with groups of highly correlated variables.
descriptions.rfReg: Random forest regression: tree-based regression that robustly handles nonlinear relationships.
descriptions.xgboostReg: XGBoost regression: gradient-boosted tree regression with strong tabular-data performance.
descriptions.km: Kaplan-Meier: a covariate-free baseline overall survival curve (C-index approximately 0.5) used as a reference.
descriptions.coxph: Cox proportional hazards model: the classic semiparametric survival model that reports a hazard ratio (HR) for each variable.
descriptions.rsf: Random survival forest: tree-based survival analysis that can capture nonlinear risk relationships.
descriptions.gbs: Gradient-boosted survival model (Cox PH loss): a boosting method for survival data.
descriptions.deepsurv: DeepSurv: a deep neural network version of the Cox model (an optional plugin requiring a torch environment).
descriptions.dummy: Majority-class baseline: always predicts the most common class to verify that the modeling pipeline is running correctly.
